name.ja: セルヴィア・ローザマリー

displayName.ja: 【波際ローズ】 セルヴィア・ローザマリー

profile.ja: 魔界貴族ローザマリー家の最後の生き残り。彼女が幼いころ、領地の下級魔族たちによる反乱で一族は悉く惨殺されたが、最後まで忠義をもって仕えた奴隷魔族の手で助けられて人間界に逃れる。しかし彼女に残ったのはごくわずかな生活資金と可愛がっていた犬型魔獣のジェロのみ。それ以来、造花作りの内職で糊口を凌ぎながら、ジェロと身を寄せ合い暮らしてきた。彼女は貧しい生活の中にあっても、人と会う時には着飾り、優雅に振る舞い、魔界貴族ローザマリー家令嬢らしくあろうとする一方、やたら特売日に詳しかったり、財布いっぱいに割引券が詰まっていたり、節約術を極めていたりと、悲しくもたくましい一面も。お茶会を開くのが好きで、もう使用人はいないため自らお茶を淹れるが、そのお茶はとてもおいしいという。ノマド傘下の企業が所有するビーチの海の家で、人手不足のためにと頼まれて手伝いをする事になったセルヴィア。人目につく以上はと、帽子やサンダルなどは無理して高級なものを揃えたが、水着はエプロンで隠れるためこだわらず、懇意にしている某魔界騎士からもらったお古を繕いなおした。だが、詰めてもまだ微妙に胸元はゆるく、逆にお尻周りはちょっとキツい。
profile.en: She is the last surviving member of the Rosemary family, a noble family from the Demon Realm. When she was a child, her family was brutally murdered in a rebellion by lower-ranking demons in their territory, but she was saved by a loyal slave demon and escaped to the Human Realm. All she had left was a small amount of living expenses and her beloved dog-like demon, Jero. Since then, she has been making a living by working on artificial flower arrangements and living with Jero. Despite her difficult life, she has studied hard and acquired knowledge and intelligence that would not shame her as a noble lady, and she has also learned the secret magic of her family, "Rose Prism," on her own. The "Rose Prism" is a magic that creates a transparent crystal in the shape of a rose using magical power and produces various effects by transmitting light. She tries to behave elegantly and like a noble lady when meeting people, but she also has a strong and sad side, being knowledgeable about special sales and having a lot of discount coupons in her wallet. She hopes to marry and restore her family's honor in the Demon Realm one day. She loves to host tea parties and always invites people she gets along with, but she has to make tea herself, as she has no servants. Her tea is very delicious. She was asked to help out at a beach house owned by a company under the Nomad umbrella due to a staffing shortage. She tried to dress elegantly, wearing a high-end hat and sandals, but her swimsuit was an old one she had altered, given to her by a certain Demon Realm knight, which she wore with an apron to cover it. However, the swimsuit was still a bit loose around the chest and tight around the hips.

text.ja: 海の家へようこそ♪　店員のセルヴィアですわ。さ、好きなものをご注文なさってくださいまし♪
text.en: Welcome to the beach house! I'm Selvia, your server. Please, order whatever you like.

text.ja: はぁ、皆さまがバカンスに興じているのに、わたくしだけお仕事なんて……ただ、これも我がローザマリー家再興のため、頑張りますわ！
text.en: Sigh, while everyone's out having fun on their vacation, I'm stuck working... but I'll do my best, since it's all for the sake of restoring my family's honor.

text.ja: おウチで悠々自適の内職も良いですが、お外で優雅に経済的社交も貴族らしくて悪くありませんわね。はいビール三つ、すぐお持ちしますわ
text.en: It's nice to have a leisurely time at home with my craft, but it's also nice to be out and about, being elegant and social in an economical way - it's very noble-like, don't you think? I'll bring you three beers right away.

text.ja: せっかくの海ですのに、お帽子を買ったせいで水着が頂き物になってしまいましたわ。次こそバリバリ稼いで、おニューの水着ですのよ
text.en: Since I spent all my money on a hat, I had to wear a hand-me-down swimsuit. Next time, I'll work hard and buy a brand new one.

text.ja: お下がり水着のサイズがキツくて、お胸のあたりがひどく窮屈ですの。それに歩くたびお尻へ食いこんで、ん、んんっ、もう限界ですわ……
text.en: This hand-me-down swimsuit is too tight, and it's really uncomfortable around my chest. And every time I walk, it digs into my butt... ugh, it's unbearable.

text.ja: わたくしにとって海の家のバイトなど造作もないことですの。ただ、知人にだけはこのスク水エプロン姿、見られたくないものですわね……
text.en: Working at the beach house is no big deal for me, but I don't want anyone I know to see me in this swimsuit and apron.

text.ja: 海の家でアフタヌーンティーセットなどいかがでしょうか？　ふふっ、夏の日差しを浴びながら優雅にお紅茶。リゾート気分、満喫できますわ
text.en: How about an afternoon tea set at the beach house? Hehe, you can enjoy tea while basking in the summer sun - it's the perfect resort vibe.

text.ja: 今回のバイトでだいぶ貯まりましたわ。でも、まだ道は遠そう……一緒に手伝ってくださる殿方がいらっしゃれば、また違うものかしら……
text.en: I've saved up a bit from this job, but I still have a long way to go... if a kind gentleman were to help me out, things might be different.

text.ja: やめてください。エッチな視線を浴びせられると、どうしても意識してしまって……はぁはぁっ、あそこの疼きが止まりませんの……
text.en: Stop it, please. When you look at me like that, I get self-conscious... and, ah, it's making me feel a certain way.

text.ja: あん、あんあん……わたくしは誰にでも身体を差しだす女では、ありませんことよ。このチンポが全て……あひ、はひぃ、悪いんですのぉ……
text.en: Ah, ah, ah... I'm not the kind of woman who gives her body to just anyone. This... ah, it's all so... bad.

text.ja: 今日は、安全日ではないんですの……だから、たくさん出して、わたくしにローザマリー家の跡継ぎを、は、孕ませてくださいませぇ……
text.en: Today is not a safe day... so, please, give me a lot, and make me pregnant with the Rosemary family's heir...
